Beyond the White Sea and towards the Straits, Xavier Almstedt would also agree to meet with a delegation from Slavaryia, a West Elseyrian nation outside the bounds of Ostman's current strategic outline, who had allegedly reached out to SummitONE for business talks. While it was unclear what exactly these discussions would entail, Almstedt would nevertheless court the idea of branching out to encompass the entirety of Elseyr and would schedule a private flight bound for Slavokets joined by some members of the SummitONE Corps of Commissionaires for unarmed security as well as a small field team from SummitONE Technologies to serve as interpreters and advisors. Additionally, an unnamed VIP is expected to serve as an additional representative of another division of SummitONE, though their name would be crossed out of SummitONE's official list of attendees for confidentiality purposes.

Covertly, the State of Norrhollow would secretly pool upwards of nearly 300 million Commonwealth dollars to help fund SummitONE's expansion efforts together with nearly 100 million from unknown sources and private honors all across High Albany, the majority of them coming in from the State of Burrow.[/spoiler][/quote]

As the SummitONE aircraft approaches the vicinity of the airport, they would be met with a sprawling metropolis, with architecture that ranges from the 18th century, to modern high-rise buildings going up to 120 meters.
The tallest building would be a single skyscraper, approximately 170 meters tall. The city itself almost appears to be separate, with the older architecture and buildings situated in the "old city", and the newer, and sleek, modern design in the "new city". Residential neighbourhoods, and sprawling industrial zones would largely exist on the outskirts, and in the dockyards.

While the SummitONE delegation are sure to scoff at the dreary, and low-brow design of the city, the air traffic control tower could contact the aircraft and direct them to a free runway, where they would land and park at a designated holding bay.
As the aircraft finally touches down, and parks itself at the holding bay, they might see a convoy of black, unmarked vehicles, ranging from sedans to SUVs.
The convoy would stop to the side of the aircraft, where the sideway door would touch the ground.

The airport seems very quite. There's no incoming or departing aircraft. This could indicate a lack of a tourist industry, or perhaps airport activities were temporarily suspended, in light of recent events.

Several men of black-clad suits, and earpieces, would exit the sedans, with the exception of the drivers. They would stand still, clasping their wrists at their front.
One of these agents, who might have been seen speaking on his phone, would walk to the centre between the convoy and the aircraft, sliding his phone back into his pocket.

[i]"Greetings, esteemed guests!"[/i] the agent would say, perhaps a bit too peppy for ones liking. A particularly perceptive eye would notice his forced smile. You might deduce he's under orders to appear as friendly and welcoming as possible.
[i]"I hope you had a pleasant trip. Welcome to Slakovets, capital of Slavaryia. Might I see your access permits, please?" [/i]
